scope: First remote launch attempt for the initial 10-second AC-WM action window
summary: The first remote window-0 launch failed before experiment initialization because the robot identity reference from a multi-file rsync command had not landed at the declared remote path.
evidence: outputs/minimax-h3-long-action-control/20260811T034500Z-10s-v1/window-00-launch.log records ValueError: experiment input does not exist or is empty for input/robot-reference.png.
No window-00-h3/metadata.json or generated candidate was created.
The failure occurred before model loading and before a CUDA process was created.
lessons: Verify every remote input by content hash after transfer instead of inferring success from a preceding directory rsync.
Keep required identity, mask, and policy files at explicit stable names in the remote run input directory.
limitations: This attempt contains no model or video-quality result.
next_actions: Transfer each required file to an explicit destination, compare local and remote SHA-256 values, and launch into a new immutable window-00-h3-v2 directory.
